steps.en: Classified vehicles are recognised and their notices marked type V
steps.id: Classified vehicle dikenali dan notice-nya ditandai tipe V

steps.en: Notices of classified vehicles at the last reminder stage get a temporary suspension
steps.id: Notice classified vehicle di tahap reminder terakhir diberi suspend sementara

steps.en: The suspension is only allowed before the case goes to court
steps.id: Suspend hanya boleh sebelum kasus masuk pengadilan

steps.en: The suspension period comes from a setting for this suspension code
steps.id: Periode suspend diambil dari pengaturan untuk kode suspend ini
steps.why_en: The actual number of days sits in the database and cannot be confirmed from the code.
steps.why_id: Jumlah hari sebenarnya ada di database dan tidak bisa dipastikan dari code.

steps.en: Suspended notices stay out of the next letter run
steps.id: Notice yang disuspend tidak ikut kiriman letter berikutnya
steps.why_en: Only the letter queue was verified; other stage movements were not traced.
steps.why_id: Hanya antrean letter yang terbukti; perpindahan tahap lain tidak ditelusuri.
